how_to_read: units are stated per field; percent values are in percent, prices in quote units
caveats: All market series are daily closes; a decision on this date can only use data up to the prior close (see leak_rule per dataset in catalog.json).
similar_days uses days strictly BEFORE the target date, so it is not look-ahead, but the neighbour count is small (12) — read the spread of outcomes, not the average.
No field here is a recommendation; base rates are priors measured on overlapping windows with the stated n_effective.
